Arkopharma Laboratoires Pharmaceutiques.note: Dermapharm AG completed the acquisition of Arkopharma Group in January 2023.

Biogena Middle East.note: Biogena Middle East functions as part of the 100% family-owned Austrian premium supplement manufacturer BIOGENA Group, which expands via regional sales structures and retail partnerships in the UAE and has never been acquired.

Country Life, LLC.note: Lion Equity Partners acquired Country Life, LLC from KI NutriCare Inc. (a subsidiary of Kikkoman Corporation) in August 2023.

ESI S.p.A..note: Innovatec S.p.A. agreed to acquire and merge ESI S.p.A. into its operations in May 2026.

Laboratoires Nutreov Physcience.note: Physcience merged with Laboratoires Nutreov under the Noreva Pharma group in 2009.

NATURELO Premium Supplements, LLC.note: Arcadia Consumer Healthcare, Inc. completed the acquisition of NATURELO in October 2020.

Nature's Craft.note: Natures Craft was sold to a strategic buyer in October 2021, and its brand is now owned by Viva 5 Group, LLC.

Nutravita Limited.note: Karo Pharma (now Karo Healthcare) acquired Nutravita Limited in 2022 as part of its acquisition of the Sylphar Group.

Pharma M S.A.L..note: Pharma M S.A.L. is an independent Lebanese pharmaceutical company founded by Marwan Malek and has no record of being acquired.

QGlobal Holdings, LLC.note: Sanofi acquired QRIB Intermediate Holdings, LLC, the parent company of Qunol, in September 2023.

Solgar.note: Nestlé acquired the core brands of The Bountiful Company, including Solgar, in August 2021.

Trace Minerals Research, LLC.note: Rosewood Private Investments acquired Trace Minerals in February 2022.
